title: Battery and starting trouble
purpose: Public page: free battery test, replacement price range, the cold-weeks rush.
facts: Battery test is free (catalogue battery_test, 0.1 h, price 0).
Replacement range = economy to premium totals of battery_replace (group 24F reference).
Battery rush: first cold weeks, November (design S11, curve battery).
Battery warranty: the maker's free-replacement period on the label (policies/warranty.md).

list_items.item: Test: free, ten minutes, no appointment. We test the battery, the starter draw and the alternator output and give you the printout.

Replacement: $198.28 to $334.95 installed, for the common size. The price depends on the grade; cars with stop-start need the AGM type, which is the top of that range. We clean the terminals and recycle the old battery.
Not the battery? If the battery tests good and the car still will not start, it is the starter, the alternator or a drain. An advisor will explain what the test showed.
